name: LiDAR4D Optimization Loss
definition: The total reconstruction loss for LiDAR4D optimization, combining depth, intensity, ray-drop, flow, and refinement losses to train the dynamic neural field for novel space-time view LiDAR synthesis.
summary: The LiDAR4D Optimization Loss trains dynamic neural fields for LiDAR synthesis by combining depth, intensity, ray-drop, flow, and refinement losses, distinguished by its ray-drop refinement term and multi-planar hash grid representations.
